popup.title: AIMailHelper
popup.provider.label: Provider: {provider}
options.title: AIMailHelper — Settings
options.provider.activeHint: Provider used for all AI tasks.
options.provider.apiKeyKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the saved key.
options.provider.permissionWarning: The extension will send your API key to {origin}. Make sure this is an endpoint you trust.
options.model.fetchFailed: Could not load the list — manual entry still works and saving is not blocked.
options.model.noFetchSupport: This provider doesn't support listing — enter the model manually.
options.model.anthropicCorsNote: The Anthropic list may be blocked by CORS (spike unverified) — enter manually on failure.
options.prompts.customHint: Leave empty to use the default prompt. The anti-injection clause is always appended.
options.vision.warning: When enabled and both T1+T2 fail, a screenshot of the OWA window is sent to the LLM provider you configured to locate the element. OFF by default (BR-03).
options.vision.vlModelPlaceholder: e.g. gpt-4o (blank = use main model if VL-capable)
options.vision.vlModelHint: Rule: dedicated VL model (this box) → main model if its name is VL-capable (gpt-4o, claude, gemini…) → otherwise skip attachment vision-read.
options.vision.modelNote: VL model is configured in "Vision Model" section (below Model section).
options.visionModel.placeholder: e.g. gpt-4o (blank = use main model if VL-capable)
options.visionModel.dedicatedHint: Priority: dedicated VL model (this box) → main model if VL-capable (gpt-4o, claude, gemini…) → otherwise skip attachment vision-read.
options.visionModel.apiKeyHint: VL model API key (if provider requires)
options.visionModel.mainModelIsVL: Main model ({model}) IS VL-capable — will be used automatically
options.visionModel.mainModelVLActive: ✓ Main model supports vision → will use main model
options.visionModel.mainModelNotVL: Main model does NOT support VL — please enter Dedicated VL Model above
options.visionModel.enableHint: When enabled, Word/Excel attachments will be read via Vision (OCR via preview screenshots).
options.automation.enableWarning: When enabled, the content of NEW emails will AUTOMATICALLY be sent to the LLM provider you configured for analysis and drafting. Drafts are only inserted after you approve them in the review queue; the extension will NEVER send emails by itself.
options.automation.rules.title: Auto-reply rules
options.automation.rules.hint: New mail matching ALL filled criteria will be auto-drafted into the approval queue. A rule with no criteria is ignored (BR-13).
options.automation.rules.subject: Subject contains
options.automation.rules.empty: No rules yet — no mail will be auto-drafted.
options.automation.rules.needCriteria: A rule needs at least one filled criterion (BR-13 fail-closed).
options.general.keyStorageSyncNote: Your API key is stored and synced through your Google account / Chrome Sync unless you choose "This device only" (chrome.storage.local).
options.general.keyStorageLocalNote: "This device only" keeps the key in chrome.storage.local — it never leaves this device.
options.general.privacyNote: Email content is only sent to the LLM endpoint you configure.
options.chat.hint: Chat goes through the active provider, streamed over the Port like the AI panel.
options.chat.needConfig: No active provider configured — save the configuration above first.
panel.title: AIMailHelper
panel.comingSoon: The AI panel becomes active in {phase}.
panel.consent.banner: First use: the content of emails you open will be sent to the LLM endpoint you configure for analysis.
panel.analyze.copilotSource: Summary from Copilot (Outlook) — shown verbatim, no local AI involved.
panel.reply.title: AI reply composer
panel.reply.copyHint: Insert failed — copy the draft from the preview and paste it manually (tip: run Diagnose if it keeps failing).
panel.reply.needsConfirm: The compose box already has content. Choose how to insert:
panel.reply.mismatch: This draft belongs to a different email — NOT inserting automatically.
panel.copilotReply.title: Draft reply with Copilot
panel.copilotReply.noPanel: Copilot panel not found — open the Copilot panel and try again.
panel.copilotReply.failed: Could not draft a reply — try again in a few minutes.
panel.unread.title: Unread mail — analysis
panel.unread.readonly: Reads only visible content without opening mail, so read/unread state is unchanged.
panel.triage.title: Digest — Priority emails
panel.triage.empty: No Triage results yet. Run Triage inbox first.
panel.triage.folderStopped: Folder changed — scanning stopped safely; existing results are kept.
panel.triage.failedNote: {count} emails could not be scored (error or missing data).
panel.queue.title: Auto-mode approval queue
panel.queue.summary: Inserted {approved} drafts into Reply; {failed} failed (kept in queue).
panel.queue.mismatch: The source email is no longer open — open it and approve again (draft stays in queue).
panel.queue.full: Queue is full (max 200) — auto-draft paused; approve some items and retry.
panel.queue.noSend: The extension never sends — you must click Send in Outlook yourself.
panel.diagnose.title: OWA layout diagnose report
panel.diagnose.privacy: [EF-3] The report contains structure + functional labels only; review it before attaching to a bug report.
panel.analyze.parseFailed: AI output did not match the expected format (EF-6).
errors.corsBlocked: Could not reach the provider (CORS). Check the endpoint/browser permissions.
errors.invalidKey: API key is invalid or lacks permission.
errors.rateLimited: Provider rate limit hit. Please retry later.
errors.timeout: Timed out waiting for the provider response.
errors.localProviderUnreachable: Cannot reach the local LLM. Check Ollama/LM Studio and the OLLAMA_ORIGINS guide.
errors.localOriginsHint: Ollama refused the connection. Set the environment variable OLLAMA_ORIGINS=chrome-extension://* and restart Ollama.
errors.owaNotFound: Could not locate the Outlook element (layout may have changed).
errors.streamInterrupted: The stream was interrupted. Received content is kept.
errors.streamFailed: The stream failed with an unexpected error. Please try again.
errors.storageQuota: Storage failed or is full. Clear the cache and retry.
errors.insertFailed: Could not insert the draft into the compose box. Copy it from the preview.
errors.emptyEmail: The email is empty or unreadable.
errors.missingConfig: A required configuration field is missing.
errors.missingMessageId: Could not determine the message-id of the email.
errors.hostPermission: The extension lacks permission for this host. Grant it in Options.
errors.reloadRequired: The extension was reloaded — please refresh the Outlook tab (F5) and try again.
errors.badRequest: The request is invalid or was rejected by the provider.
errors.providerOverloaded: The provider is overloaded. It will retry automatically.
errors.contentFilter: Content was blocked by the provider's filter.
errors.safetyBlocked: Content was blocked by the model's safety policy.
errors.modelsNotSupported: This provider doesn't support model listing — enter the model manually.
errors.tooLarge: Content is too long — shorten it and retry.
